note: Seeded fabrications for the claim checker's catch rate (carnet#854). Each case is a coach reply carrying exactly one false sentence about a synthetic athlete; `truth` states what that athlete's record actually says. HRV, sleep and CTL are not fields the checker reads, so for those cases `truth` is the only record of them. Today is Thursday 2026-10-08 for every athlete. Every athlete with a provider is fully synced: the record is read this turn over the 90 days to today, the provider's list head was read this turn, and its history is backfilled to the end of its feed, so the activities listed are every session of that quarter and a total stated over a week or a month is checked against them.
